_comment: PROLACTIN calibration config. Paths relative to this file. Profile name lookup is case-insensitive (resolved by CalibrationManager).
_default_profile_note: The default profile is NOT set here -- it lives in config/DEFAULTS.py as 'default_headphone_calibration_profile'. The operator can override it per run from the dropdown in the paradigm setup dialog.
_retspl_note: The 'retspl' block in each profile maps frequency (Hz) to the RETSPL offset (dB) used for dB SPL -> dB HL conversion: dB_HL = dB_SPL - RETSPL(freq). The table is the ISO 389-8:2004 / ANSI S3.6-2018 HDA200 circumaural set (IEC 60318-1 ear), applied to the circumaural DT250 / AKG K271 as a research-grade approximation; the residual RECD difference between DT250 and HDA200 is unquantified but expected small (circumaural-to-circumaural). Research display only - not clinical. Set 'retspl' to null on a profile to disable dB HL conversion for it.

beyerdynamic_dt250_a_ucx2._description: Beyerdynamic DT250 250 ohm, unit A, over RME UCX II. HP gain locked via TotalMix 'Store to device' + Lock Keys ALL. Inverse filter measured 2026-05-18, REW min-phase, 4096 taps, t=0 at sample 256, 48 kHz, 32-bit float, 'Exclude notches from inversion' OFF, lower freq limit 20 Hz. SPL calibration completed.

spl_calibration._description: Reference amplitude is peak (not RMS). Method: -20 dB FS peak (= 0.1 linear) 1 kHz sine routed through CalibrationManager pipeline (inverse IR applied) at locked hardware gain; reduce a known attenuation in software until REW SPL meter reads target (e.g. 94 dB); stored peak amp = 0.1 * 10**(attenuation_dB / 20). Per-channel scaling is applied via spl_to_amplitude().

retspl.source: ISO 389-8:2004 / ANSI S3.6-2018 HDA200 RETSPL (IEC 60318-1). Applied to circumaural DT250/K271 as approximation; residual RECD difference (DT250 vs HDA200) unquantified. Research display only - not clinical.

neurospec_er2_c_ucx2._description: Neurospec / Etymotic ER-2 insert earphone, unit C, over RME UCX II ANALOG 1/2 line outputs (NOT the front headphone jack - the ER-2 uses a split 2x mono-jack connector). INSERT earphone - NOT circumaural. Inverse filter measured 2026-07-09 on a B&K type 4157 artificial ear (IEC 60318-4 occluded-ear simulator) with a fixture for the foam eartip, NOT the 4153 used for the over-ear profiles. CAVEAT: the exact mic calibration data for the mic inside the 4157 could not be located; the mic cal file from the previous over-ear (4153) round was reused as an approximation. A mic cal file characterises the microphone, not the coupler body, so reuse is defensible for the same physical mic, but this is unverified - re-measure with the correct cal file before any clinical use. SPL calibration completed 2026-07-09.

spl_calibration._description: The ER-2 is a 10 ohm load driven from LINE outputs, which are current-limited into it. Achievable full-scale SPL on this chain is ~90.6 dB (measured, left ear); max_spl is set to 87 = 90.6 - 3 dB headroom. This is far below the over-ear profiles (which reach ~123 dB) and is the reason reference_amplitude here is NOT the shared over-ear value: it is raised to 0.5 to anchor near the top of the usable range for better meter SNR while staying ~7 dB below clipping. Method: fixed digital peak amplitude 0.5 (post-FIR peak 0.44 = -7.1 dBFS, confirmed on the TotalMix meter), 1 kHz sine routed through the CalibrationManager pipeline (inverse IR applied), one ear at a time on the 4157; measured SPL recorded per ear. Linearity verified 2026-07-09 on the right ear over a 30 dB range (10 dB request steps tracked within 0.6 dB); the 47 dB point is noisier as it sits ~26 dB above the 28 dB noise floor. Per-channel scaling is applied via spl_to_amplitude(). NOTE: requesting a level above max_spl is clamped, but spl_to_amplitude() does NOT guard against the resulting amplitude exceeding 1.0 on low-ceiling profiles - watch TotalMix for clipping when changing hardware gain.
